# Stratara — generated reference

Generated from the published assemblies and their XML documentation. Do not edit by hand;
a build regenerates it and fails on a difference. The guides live in `docs/`, the guarantees
in the capability specifications — this file is the lookup table underneath both.

## Configuration

Every bindable options type, the section it binds from, and the default each key carries.

### `BusEnvelopeIntegrity` — Stratara.Abstractions.Messaging.BusEnvelopeIntegrityOptions

| `BusEnvelopeIntegrity:SharedKey` | `Byte[]` | — |

## Registrations

Public extension methods a host calls to wire Stratara, with what each one does and needs.

| Registration | Package | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `AddAggregatesFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Scans the assembly containing T for concrete IAggregate implementations and registers each in the trusted-type resolver — together with every event type consumed by the aggregate's Apply(...) methods — so both SnapshotService can materialize the aggregate and IAggregationService can replay its event stream without further AddTrustedType<TEvent>() calls |
| `AddApiKeyStore<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core IApiKeyStore against TContext — issuance (raw key shown once, hash stored), idempotent import of a caller-supplied key for bootstrap scenarios, fail-closed validation, revocation, and per-tenant/per-user erasure sweeps |
| `AddApiKeyStoreFromContextFactory<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core IApiKeyStore against TContext, taking a fresh context for each operation from the registered context factory |
| `AddAspNetIdentity<TUser, TIdentityDbContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | — |
| `AddAspNetIdentityWithSignInManager<TUser, TIdentityDbContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | — |
| `AddAuthorizingCommandOutboxDispatcher()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers AuthorizingCommandOutboxDispatcher as the ICommandOutboxDispatcher (scoped), keeping the inner CommandOutboxDispatcher available for direct resolution |
| `AddAuthorizingMediator<TAuthorizationProvider>()` | Stratara.Mediator | Register TAuthorizationProvider as the IAuthorizationProvider implementation and wire IMediator to dispatch through an authorizing decorator that enforces RequireRoleAttribute annotations on the request type before delegating to the inner mediator |
| `AddAzureServiceBus(String connectionString)` | Stratara.Outbox.AzureServiceBus | Registers the Stratara Azure Service Bus message bus using a SAS-token connection string |
| `AddAzureServiceBusWithManagedIdentity(String fullyQualifiedNamespace, TokenCredential credential)` | Stratara.Outbox.AzureServiceBus | Registers the Stratara Azure Service Bus message bus using Azure-AD authentication (Managed Identity by default, or a caller-supplied TokenCredential) |
| `AddBackendServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the API-host stack: common framework services (messaging, identity, session, security, mapping, resilience) + mediator + write store + outbox dispatcher |
| `AddBackgroundTasks()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers QueuedHostedService and a singleton IBackgroundTaskQueue with a default capacity of 100 pending items |
| `AddBusEnvelopeIntegrity(Action<BusEnvelopeIntegrityOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Opt in to HMAC integrity protection on every bus envelope |
| `AddBusEnvelopeIntegrity(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Opt in to HMAC integrity protection on every bus envelope |
| `AddBusEnvelopeIntegrity(String base64SharedKey, BusEnvelopeIntegrityMode mode)` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Opt in to HMAC integrity protection on every bus envelope |
| `AddCaching()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers a singleton IConnectionMultiplexer built from the ConnectionStrings:redis configuration entry |
| `AddCatalogPermissionResolver()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register CatalogPermissionResolver as the IPermissionResolver — permissions derive from tenant-scoped membership roles mapped through the catalog's role grants |
| `AddCatalogPermissionResolver<TUser>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register CatalogPermissionResolver as the IPermissionResolver — permissions derive from tenant-scoped membership roles mapped through the catalog's role grants |
| `AddCommandAuditing()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.Pipeline.CommandAudit | Registers the CommandAuditBehavior pipeline behaviors for both IRequest (void commands) and IRequest`1 (commands with a result) |
| `AddCommandHandlersFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Mediator | Scan the assembly containing T and register every concrete ICommandHandler`1 implementation as a scoped service |
| `AddCommandWorkerServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the command-worker stack: common framework services + mediator + mediator-worker (hosted service that consumes the command topic into the in-process mediator) + write store + event sourcing + outbox dispatcher |
| `AddCommonFrameworkServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Wires the cross-cutting Stratara framework services that every worker host depends on — messaging, identity, session context, security, event-mapping, and resilience pipelines |
| `AddDefaultHealthChecks<TBuilder>()` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults.AspNetCore | Registers a baseline health check (`self`) that always returns Healthy and is tagged live, so it shows up on both the /health and /alive endpoints once mapped via MapDefaultEndpoints |
| `AddDevelopmentNoOpEmailSender<TUser>()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | — |
| `AddDomainEventTypesFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Scans the assembly containing T and registers only the event types consumed by the aggregates' Apply(TEvent) methods — without registering the aggregate types themselves and without registering any projection / saga / command-handler classes into DI |
| `AddEventProjectionWorkerServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the event-projection-worker stack: common framework services + write store + projection replay state + projection worker (hosted service) |
| `AddEventSourcing()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers the core event-sourcing services as scoped: IEventSource, IAggregationService, IChangeSetHandler, IEventTypeResolver, and ISnapshotService |
| `AddEventStoreHealthCheck(String name, HealthStatus? failureStatus, IEnumerable<String> tags)` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Registers the EventStoreHealthCheck, verifying that the event-store (write-side) database is reachable |
| `AddEventStreamHashWorker()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers EventStreamHashWorker as a hosted service and the supporting IEventStreamHashService / IEventChainService implementations |
| `AddEventStreamHashWorkerServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the event-stream-hash-worker stack: common framework services + write store + event-stream-hashing worker |
| `AddEventUpcaster<TUpcaster>()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Registers TUpcaster as an IEventUpcaster and ensures the default IEventUpcasterPipeline is present |
| `AddEventUpcaster(IEventUpcaster upcaster)` | Stratara.Abstractions | Registers TUpcaster as an IEventUpcaster and ensures the default IEventUpcasterPipeline is present |
| `AddEventUpcasterPipeline()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Registers the default IEventUpcasterPipeline if no implementation has been registered yet |
| `AddHeavyCommandWorker(Int32? degreeOfParallelism)` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers a dedicated heavy-command MediatorCommandWorker lane as a hosted service |
| `AddHeavyCommandWorkerServices(Int32? degreeOfParallelism)` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the heavy-command-worker stack: the same full command-handling stack as AddCommandWorkerServices but with a dedicated heavy-command lane instead of the interactive one |
| `AddIdentity()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers the scoped ITenantService and ICurrentUserService implementations that resolve their values from the ambient ISessionContextProvider |
| `AddMapping()` | Stratara.Shared | Registers the singleton IEventMapperFactory implementation used by the event-sourcing stack to materialize typed IEvent instances from persisted EventStreamEntry / EventMessage rows |
| `AddMediator()` | Stratara.Mediator | Register IMediator as a scoped service |
| `AddMediatorWorker()` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers the interactive MediatorCommandWorker as a hosted service |
| `AddMembershipAuthorization()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register MembershipAuthorizationProvider as the IAuthorizationProvider — role checks pass on tenant-scoped membership roles only |
| `AddMembershipAuthorization<TUser>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register MembershipAuthorizationProvider as the IAuthorizationProvider — role checks pass on tenant-scoped membership roles only |
| `AddMembershipCrossTenantAuthorizer(Action<MembershipCrossTenantAuthorizerOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register MembershipCrossTenantAuthorizer as the ICrossTenantAuthorizer consulted by strict tenant isolation: cross-tenant operations are allowed for actors with an active membership in the data-owner tenant or with one of the configured cross-tenant roles |
| `AddMembershipTenantClaim<TUser>()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Decorate the registered IUserClaimsPrincipalFactory`1 with MembershipClaimsPrincipalFactory`1, stamping the tenant claim into every issued principal (cookies and ASP.NET Identity bearer tokens) |
| `AddMembershipTenantClaimsTransformation()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register MembershipClaimsTransformation as an IClaimsTransformation, resolving the tenant claim from the membership store on every request |
| `AddMessaging()` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers the messaging infrastructure: IMessageBus backed by RabbitMqBus, the IMessagingIdentifier service, and binds MessagingOptions from the Messaging configuration section |
| `AddNpgsqlIdentityDbContextFactory<TDbContext>()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Registers an Npgsql-backed IDbContextFactory`1 for an identity-store DbContext together with a scoped resolution of the context itself (so ASP.NET Identity can inject it directly) and the default IDbResolver |
| `AddNpgsqlReadDbContextFactory<TDbContext>()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Registers an Npgsql-backed IDbContextFactory`1 for a read-store DbContext together with the read-side unit of work over it, and the default IDbResolver if none has been registered yet |
| `AddNpgsqlWriteDbContextFactory<TDbContext>()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Registers an Npgsql-backed IDbContextFactory`1 for a write-store DbContext together with the write-side unit of work over it, and the default IDbResolver if none has been registered yet |
| `AddOutboxDispatcher()` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers ICommandOutboxDispatcher and IEventBundleOutboxDispatcher (scoped) and, transitively, IProjectionReplayState (singleton via AddProjectionReplayState) |
| `AddOutboxHealthCheck(Int32? degradedThreshold, Int32? unhealthyThreshold, String name, HealthStatus? failureStatus, IEnumerable<String> tags)` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Registers the OutboxBacklogHealthCheck, reporting the depth and age of the Stratara outbox backlog |
| `AddOutboxWorker(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers the OutboxWorker hosted service and binds OutboxOptions from configuration |
| `AddOutboxWorkerServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the outbox-worker stack: common framework services + write store + outbox dispatcher + outbox-retry worker |
| `AddPermissionCatalog(Action<PermissionCatalog> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Build and register the application's PermissionCatalog (singleton) — the declared permission vocabulary plus its role→permission grants, consumed by the catalog permission resolvers and the HTTP permission policies |
| `AddPipelineBehavior(Type openGenericBehaviorType)` | Stratara.Mediator | Register an open-generic IPipelineBehavior`1 implementation for void commands |
| `AddPipelineBehaviorWithResult(Type openGenericBehaviorType)` | Stratara.Mediator | Register an open-generic IPipelineBehavior`2 implementation |
| `AddProjectionReplayState()` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Registers the singleton Redis-backed IProjectionReplayState |
| `AddProjectionWorker(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.Projections | Registers the projection runtime — ProjectionManager, ProjectionHandler, ProjectionMethodInvoker, ProjectionWorker, and ProjectionReplayWorker — and binds ProjectionOptions from configuration |
| `AddProjectionsFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Projections | Scans the assembly containing T and registers every concrete IProjection implementation it finds as a scoped service |
| `AddQueryHandlersFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Mediator | Scan the assembly containing T and register every concrete IQueryHandler`2 implementation as a scoped service |
| `AddRedisOutboxLock()` | Stratara.Outbox.RabbitMQ | Replaces the default NullOutboxLock with the Redis-backed RedisOutboxLock, enabling safe multi-instance outbox-worker deployments |
| `AddResiliencePipelines()` | Stratara.Resilience | Register every Stratara named resilience pipeline (MessageBus, CommandDispatcher, EventBundleDispatcher, ConcurrencyConflict, PrecedingFact, ProjectionReplayBatch) with the application's Polly registry |
| `AddSagaWorker(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.Sagas | Registers the saga runtime services (ISagaManager, ISagaHandler, ISagaMethodInvoker) and the hosted SagaWorker; binds SagaOptions from the Sagas configuration section |
| `AddSagaWorkerServices()` | Stratara.EventSourcing.WorkerDefaults | Registers the saga-worker stack: common framework services + write store + event sourcing + outbox dispatcher + saga worker (hosted service that reacts to event bundles) |
| `AddSagasFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Sagas | Scans the assembly that contains T for concrete ISaga implementations and registers each as a scoped ISaga |
| `AddSecurity()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers Stratara's security stack: ISecureJsonSerializer, the AES-GCM blob encryptor and IEncryptionFactory (delegated to Stratara.Security), and a development-onlyIKeyStore fallback (DummyKeyStore) |
| `AddSessionContext()` | Stratara.Sessions | Register the concrete ISessionContextProvider implementation as a scoped service plus the SessionContextOptions binding |
| `AddSettingCatalog(Action<SettingCatalog> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Build and register the application's SettingCatalog (singleton) — the declared setting vocabulary with defaults and flags, consumed by the setting provider and the encrypting store decorator |
| `AddSettingStore<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core ISettingStore against TContext, plus the scope-fallback ISettingProvider read facade |
| `AddSettingStoreFromContextFactory<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core ISettingStore against TContext and the scope-fallback ISettingProvider read facade, taking a fresh context for each operation from the registered context factory |
| `AddStrataraApiKey(Action<ApiKeyAuthenticationOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register the Stratara API-key authentication scheme (SchemeName) |
| `AddStrataraAuthSchemeSelector(Action<StrataraAuthSchemeSelectorOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register the Stratara auth-scheme selector (SchemeName): a policy scheme that routes each request by shape — API-key header → API-key scheme, Authorization: Bearer → bearer scheme, everything else → the fallback (cookie) scheme |
| `AddStrataraBlobEncryption()` | Stratara.Security | Register the AES-GCM blob encryptor and encryption factory |
| `AddStrataraErasure()` | Stratara.Infrastructure | Registers ISubjectEraser, which composes the membership, API-key, setting and key-material sweeps into one operation |
| `AddStrataraExternalLoginProvisioning<TUser>(Action<ExternalLoginProvisioningOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register ExternalLoginProvisioningService`1 and its options |
| `AddStrataraFileKeyStore(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.Security | Register the production file-backed key store: a FileMasterKeyProvider (KEK custody), the EnvelopeFileKeyStore as IKeyStore, the AES-GCM blob encryptor, and a startup probe that validates the KEK eagerly |
| `AddStrataraJwtBearer(IConfiguration configuration, String sectionName, String scheme)` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register the API JWT-bearer validation scheme from configuration (default section Identity:JwtBearer) |
| `AddStrataraOpenIdConnect(IConfiguration configuration, String sectionName, String scheme)` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register the interactive OpenID Connect sign-in scheme from configuration (default section Identity:OpenIdConnect) |
| `AddStrataraPermissionPolicies()` | Stratara.Identity.AspNetCore | Register the permission policy provider and handler: every permission declared in the registered PermissionCatalog becomes an on-demand authorization policy — [Authorize("sims.read")] / .RequireAuthorization("sims.read") — evaluated through the registered IPermissionResolver |
| `AddStrataraProblemDetails()` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults.AspNetCore | Registers StrataraProblemDetailsExceptionHandler and the ASP.NET problem-details service, so a validation rejection becomes 400 with the failures grouped by field, and an authorization refusal or tenant-access denial becomes 403 — all in one shape |
| `AddStrataraResilienceBehavior()` | Stratara.Resilience | Register the resilience pipeline behavior so any mediator request implementing IResilientRequest is dispatched inside the named Polly pipeline it selects |
| `AddStrataraTenantIsolation(Action<TenantIsolationOptions> configure)` | Stratara.Mediator | Register the tenant-isolation pipeline behaviors for both request shapes (IRequest and IRequest`1) |
| `AddStrataraTestingEventStore<TWriteDbContext>(SqliteConnection sharedConnection, Guid defaultTenantId)` | Stratara.Testing.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the event-sourcing write stack (IEventSource, IAggregationService, snapshots, the EF Core write store) over sharedConnection, plus an InMemoryKeyStore, a TestSessionContextProvider, and a RecordingEventBundleOutboxDispatcher |
| `AddStrataraValidation()` | Stratara.Validation | Register the validation pipeline behaviors for both request shapes (IRequest and IRequest`1) |
| `AddTenantMembershipStore<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core ITenantMembershipStore against TContext |
| `AddTenantMembershipStoreFromContextFactory<TContext>()` | Stratara.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore | Register the EF Core ITenantMembershipStore against TContext, taking a fresh context for each operation from the registered context factory |
| `AddTrustedType<T>()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Registers T in the trusted-type allowlist |
| `AddTrustedTypeResolver()` | Stratara.Abstractions | Registers the ITrustedTypeResolver as a singleton if no implementation has been registered yet |
| `AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<T>()` | Stratara.Validation | Scan the assembly containing T and register every concrete IValidator`1 implementation as a scoped service against each closed IValidator`1 interface it implements |
| `AddWriteStore(IConfiguration configuration)` | Stratara.EventSourcing.EntityFrameworkCore | Binds EventSourcingOptions from the EventSourcing configuration section so write-side components (event-stream/snapshot/outbox repositories) can resolve host-tuned settings such as snapshot cadence and batch sizes |
| `ConfigureAspNetOpenTelemetry<TBuilder>()` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults.AspNetCore | Wires ASP.NET Core request instrumentation on metrics + tracing on top of the base pipeline configured by ConfigureOpenTelemetry |
| `ConfigureOpenTelemetry<TBuilder>(Action<MeterProviderBuilder> configureMetrics, Action<TracerProviderBuilder> configureTracing)` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults | Configures OpenTelemetry logging + metrics + tracing on the given host builder |
| `ConfigureSerilog()` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults | Registers Serilog as the host's logging provider with Stratara defaults (destructuring attributes, async console sink, OTLP sink when configured) |
| `MapDefaultEndpoints(Boolean requireAuthorizationOnHealth)` | Stratara.ServiceDefaults.AspNetCore | Maps the standard health endpoints: /health (full report) and /alive (only checks tagged live) |

## Exceptions

What the framework throws. Catching one of these is a contract; catching `Exception` is not.

| Exception | Package | Thrown when |
|---|---|---|
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Authorization.AuthorizationException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by the authorizing mediator/dispatcher decorators when the caller does not hold a role required by RequireRoleAttribute on the dispatched request type |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Authorization.PermissionAuthorizationException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by the authorizing mediator/dispatcher decorators when the caller does not hold a permission required by RequirePermissionAttribute on the dispatched request type |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Erasure.ErasureIncompleteException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Raised when one plane's sweep fails during a composed erasure |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.EventSourcing.ConcurrencyException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by SaveChangesAsync when another writer committed to the same stream first and the optimistic version check fails |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.EventSourcing.PrecedingFactMissingException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Reports that the entity a fact refers to does not exist in the handler's read model yet, so the fact cannot be applied until the fact that created the entity has been |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Multitenancy.TenantAccessDeniedException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by the tenant-isolation pipeline behavior when an ITenantScopedRequest is rejected: either its TenantId does not match the current session's data-owner tenant, or strict mode observed an unauthorized cross-tenant operation |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Persistence.ConcurrencyConflictException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by an ITransaction implementation when an optimistic-concurrency conflict is detected during commit (i.e |
| `Stratara.Abstractions.Validation.StrataraValidationException` | Stratara.Abstractions | Thrown by the validation pipeline behavior when a request fails validation with one or more Error-severity failures |

## Names on the wire

Identifiers Stratara uses outside its own process — what an operator provisions and what a
cache holds. Topic and subscription names are the fallbacks used when `Messaging:Topics`
configures nothing.

| Name | Kind | Declared by |
|---|---|---|
| `command` | topic | MessagingIdentifier |
| `command-subscription` | subscription | MessagingIdentifier |
| `event-bundle` | topic | MessagingIdentifier |
| `event-bundle-saga-subscription` | subscription | MessagingIdentifier |
| `event-bundle-subscription` | subscription | MessagingIdentifier |
| `heavy-command` | topic | MessagingIdentifier |
| `heavy-command-subscription` | subscription | MessagingIdentifier |
| `notifications` | topic | MessagingIdentifier |
| `stratara:outbox:lock` | cache key | RedisOutboxLock |
| `stratara:projection:replay:active` | cache key | ProjectionReplayState |
| `stratara:projection:replay:error` | cache key | ProjectionReplayState |
| `stratara:projection:replay:processed` | cache key | ProjectionReplayState |
| `stratara:projection:replay:request` | cache key | ProjectionReplayState |
| `stratara:projection:replay:total` | cache key | ProjectionReplayState |
| `stratara:setting:` | cache key | EncryptingSettingStore |
| `stratara:tenant_id` | claim type | StrataraClaimTypes |
